about: INVENTORY (2026-10-06) of what the Atlas needs: stomp (own, in the game); cannon salvo atlasshot (new: the twin cannons, every 2.0 s, WeaponOf, gain 0.35, 3 a second); footfall atlasstep (new: played by UAcEffects::Footfall for every foot that comes down, gain 0.5, 4 a second); driven pull-away atlasmove (new: PullAway, gain 0.3, at most every 2 s); report-in vatlas and death atlasdeath (BLOCKED, see below); HUD icon atlas (made: Content-src/icons/atlas.png, art/models/atlas/previews/icon.png). Picked 2026-10-06 by the numbers (the 0.4 s loudest RMS after peak normalisation, the tail, the active length): atlasshot_1 and _2 (now sfx/atlasshot_1, _2; _3 is quiet, -16 dB, and only 0.7 s alive), atlasmove_3 and _2 (now sfx/atlasmove_1, _2; _1 dies after 1.15 s), atlasstep_1 and _2 (now sfx/atlasstep_1, _2; _3 is hiss at -27 dB). All takes stay in art/models/atlas/sounds/. VOICE (2026-10-09): the ElevenLabs account has no free custom voice slot (10 of 10, all game voices), so the crew speaks with a library voice, which needs no slot: "Xavier - Big, Deep & Powerful narrator" (YRJMFMoNhLEYl3Nae0G6, a veteran soldier's deep, growly voice), picked by ear by the user from four library candidates through comm.py. The brief: a deep, slow heavy-machinery operator in his fifties, gravelly and weary, a foreman running a walking war machine. The Voice Design previews made on 2026-10-06 stay in art/models/atlas/sounds/voice/ (unsaved, expired).

entries.prompt: a giant war mech slams its huge metal foot into the ground: one massive deep thud, the earth shakes with a low rumbling shockwave, rocks and dirt rattle down, heavy hydraulic hiss, close up
colossal metal walker stomps the ground: a booming subsonic impact like a pile driver, ground cracking, a rolling rumble spreading outward, gravel scattering
heavy mechanical foot crashes down creating a seismic shockwave: deep bass boom, metallic clank of armour plates, dust whoosh rushing outward, distant rumble
earthquake stomp of a two-legged tank: servo whine rising as the leg lifts, then a thunderous ground impact with a deep echoing thump and rumbling aftershock
two heavy siege cannons mounted on a giant walker fire together: a deep booming double blast, a thunderous muzzle crack with a shockwave thump and a metallic ring, close up
massive artillery cannons of a walking war machine fire a salvo: a low roaring boom and a sharp crack, hydraulic recoil clunk, echoing rumble, close up
a pair of long heavy tank guns fire one after another: two deep concussive booms, brassy crack, smoke hiss, heavy recoil, close up
giant two-legged walker lurches into motion: heavy hydraulic servos whine, steam hiss, a deep mechanical groan and the first slow thudding step, heard from inside the cab
enormous mech powers up its legs and starts to walk: deep engine rumble, pistons and gears grinding, metal joints creaking, a ponderous heavy thump, from the cockpit
colossal walking machine's boilers roar and its servos strain as it steps off: low growling engine, hydraulic whine rising, slow booming stride, from the cab
one heavy footfall of a giant metal walker: a deep dull thud with a clank of armour plate and a gravelly crunch, short, close up
a huge mechanical foot plants on rocky ground: muffled low boom, metal clang, dust and gravel crunch, short
single stride of a colossal robot: heavy thump that shakes the ground, a servo clunk, scattering pebbles, short

entries.text: [slow, gravelly, weary] Atlas walking. Clear the road.
[deep, unhurried] Cannons loaded. Point me at the walls.
[low, steady] Big boots, slow feet. Don't rush me.
[gravelly, deliberate] Crew's aboard. Let's knock something down.
